claims.boundary: Any outcome - gate closure, NOT ESTIMABLE, or a section 5 verdict - appends to STUDY-SPEC-024/F1 as a dated replication record beside the frozen one; the claim's wording gains or loses the phrase 'on the joined subset' only by that appended record, as the evidence dictates. Genre, habit, and survival remain live rival explanations for the difference, named as such in every outcome; the within-site design controls place, not kind, and every output carries the lineage label and the scope sentence of spec section 7.3. A gate closure establishes nothing about the claim - it is a statement about the available catalogue data's joinability. Carried from the draft text: Spec 059 is a new pre-registered variant of the frozen F1 test, and no outcome under Spec 059 establishes what the seal/tablet difference means. Final restatement at the freeze recovery (0.8-draft): its frozen records are not re-adjudicated or superseded either; Spec 059 is a new pre-registered variant, and no outcome under it establishes what the seal/tablet difference means.

evidence.description: Spec 024's freeze, section 8 language fence: associations describe use, not meaning; the lineage label and joined-subset scope sentence are mandatory on every F1 statement - the fences this variant inherits.

falsification_tests: inspection: any Spec 059 product that modifies a Spec 024 file, restates the frozen verdict, presents the enlarged result as replacing it, or states a meaning, movement, or whole-corpus conclusion falsifies compliance with this requirement

metadata.boundary_confirmation: C15 states the record rule for Spec 024: its frozen records and SUPPORTED verdict stand unedited, un-re-adjudicated, and un-superseded by Spec 059. F059-C06 states the identity rule for Spec 059's own new join: a string match is a candidate, not an identity. The pair shares only the boundary of the original join's status: C15 preserves the frozen record of the original concordance join and its result; C06 bars that join's string rule from serving as this spec's enlarged join, and gate 0.2's reproduction of it - run only to re-derive the preserved baseline - is recording, not re-adjudication. Preserving a record does not license its method for new use, and barring the method does not touch the record. Both claims stand as stated; neither negates the other.
metadata.strongest_rival: the pressure to announce the enlarged result as the 'real' F1 verdict, superseding the frozen one
metadata.verdict_rule: compliance is judged by file inspection at execution close: Spec 024's pinned hashes unchanged, the frozen verdict quoted only as recorded, the outcome filed as an append

claims.text: Spec 024's frozen verdict stands unedited by Spec 059.

note: Draft register for Spec 059 (design D-22, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the approved runnable-experiments campaign (owner approval of the campaign plan as written, 2026-10-21; campaign member 16 of 20). Conventions as in Specs 032-042: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. One input is deliberately unpinned at draft: the object-ID mapping artifact (§2 of the spec) does not yet exist as a single artifact; the freeze names and pins the held source for each row's object identifier (OF-059-3). ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-F1-RECORD (the Phase-136/141 records and the combined Stage 2 report are the record of the frozen F1 test), ASM-OBJECT-ID-JOIN (an object identifier carried as cited provenance data through the Phase-130 schema identifies the same physical object in the layer and the catalogue), ASM-STRING-JOIN-UNRELIABLE (Spec 037's census: string identity conflicts in 49.21% of graded candidates, mostly on object type - string keys are never identity), ASM-TERMINAL14-FROZEN (the TERMINAL14 class and the Spec 018 canonical W-to-P mapping machinery are frozen definitions, carried unchanged), ASM-FAMILY-RULES (Spec 024 F1's CMH statistic, permutation parameters, eligibility and estimability rules are carried unchanged), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (gate censuses precede any outcome quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-LAYER-AS-HELD (the pinned ICIT-lineage layer of 5,679 rows is the population of record), ASM-MARGIN-FAMILY (the verdict thresholds of design D-22 - 0.05 on the adjusted q, 1.5 on the odds-ratio interval, 1.0 as the no-effect point - are the design's fixed margins, carried unadjusted), ASM-DESCRIPTION-NOT-CONTROL (a described covariate is not a controlled one).
